response.proposal_rule: null or an object with exactly these four keys and no others; at most one proposal; Liam never modifies it (D15)

error_body.fallback: missing, unparseable or guard-failing body gives hometown:<status>

status_decides: HTTP status alone decides retry and exit code: 5xx and timeout retry once then exit 21 hometown:unavailable; every 4xx fails without retry; the body only supplies the reason code
security: Liam sends no Authorization header; nono-proxy injects the session agent credential.
